The surname '''al'Seen''' can refer to the following people:

*[[Astelle al'Seen]] - the matriarch of the al'Seen family in the [[Two Rivers]].
*[[Ban al'Seen]] - the son of Jac and Elisa and cousin of Wil.
*[[Elisa al'Seen]] - the wife of Jac and mother of Ban.
*[[Jac al'Seen]] - a farmer in the Two Rivers, the husband of Elisa, father of Ban and cousin of Wit.
*[[Saml al'Seen]] - an [[Asha'man]] from the Two Rivers.
*[[Susa al'Seen]] - a [[Novice]] in the [[White Tower]].
*[[Wil al'Seen]] - a young man from [[Deven Ride]] and a charmer.
*[[Wit al'Seen]] - a farmer in the Two Rivers and cousin of Jac.
